s.note: the busy morning market in Belle's village
s.how: Slice a baguette, brush with olive oil and toast until golden. Top half with brie and thin slices of red apple. Top the rest with goat's cheese and a drizzle of honey. Lay them out on a wooden board like a village market stall.

s.note: Gaston bragging at the tavern about the eggs he eats
s.how: Boil 12 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Halve and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, Dijon and snipped chives until smooth. Pipe back into the whites and dust with smoked paprika. Pile onto one big platter, because no one eats eggs like Gaston.

m.note: Lumière putting on the dinner show in the castle dining room
m.how: Brown 150g diced bacon, then brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add 12 peeled baby onions and 300g mushrooms and colour lightly. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour and 2 tbsp tomato paste, then add 750ml beef stock, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar, thyme and 2 bay leaves. Cover and simmer for 3 hours. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and warm milk. Serve with crusty bread.

w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Fill with 500ml thick custard. Slice 3 red apples paper thin, soften briefly in lemony water, then arrange in overlapping circles into a rose. Bake at 180C for 20 minutes and glaze with warm apricot jam.

d.how: In a big jug, mix 750ml chilled peach nectar, the juice of 2 oranges and 1/2 tsp vanilla. Add 1 sliced orange and 1 sliced fresh peach. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 750ml chilled sparkling apple juice. Stir gently and pour into wide glasses so a peach slice lands in each.
